description: Uttar Pradesh has implemented Startup Policy-2026 to promote entrepreneurship through six pillars covering infrastructure, funding, skills, industry links, outreach and institutional support. The StartinUP portal will offer online registration, incentive applications and training resources, while a helpline and social media support will address startup-related queries.
body_lead: Lucknow, October 15, 2026: The Yogi government has implemented the Startup Policy-2026 to make Uttar Pradesh a startup hub. The policy focuses on promoting innovation, technology and entrepreneurship. Its objective is to build a robust startup ecosystem in the state, where young people can access opportunities to turn their ideas into businesses, secure financial assistance, receive expert guidance and take their products to market.
